title: 第8章 和我拼后台？你搞笑吧？
slug: 帝国的崛起全本免费-帝国的崛起最新章节列表
content_zh:
而现在德意志集团首席执政官俾斯麦也正在为这事犯愁，自己准备大建了，却还没有目标！要说玩战略、玩内政、玩外交俾斯麦至少也是最强王者的级别。但是要说海军这东西，连德国海军将领们都还没搞清楚呢，他一个门外汗怎么弄？虽然方向没定，但是根据战略指挥枪的原则，他已经有了一个大概的方向，舰队大建规模不宜过大，德国现在很安全，再保险条约依然存在，法国不敢和德国过不去，俄国顾不上和自己过不去，意大利和奥匈是朋友，英国和自己也不算敌人。环境空前的好，一支庞大的舰队对德国除了带来压力和让别人忌讳之外，没有任何作用！
而现在，这位铁血首相没有时间来想这个战略问题，因为帝国海军办公室国务秘书赫斯纳来到了首相的官邸，正在向首相汇报工作。他按照海军部的要求提供了一个大概的预算，而上面的一些情况引起了首相的注意。
“海军造舰预算有些高。而且其中的装甲预算似乎高的有些离谱，帝国的装甲生产商从来没有报出过如此高的价格。”俾斯麦指着其中一行数字说道。
“这是一个名叫巴伐利亚机械设计局的新公司提出的报价，他们的报价整整比其它公司提出的报价高出了5成以上！真不知道他们怎么想的，海军部不打算采用他们的装甲。”赫斯纳有些不满的说道。
“他们的装甲质量如何？”首相似乎不想在报价上纠缠什么，而是直接问了新式装甲的性能。
“比哈尔贝格男爵的公司和其它公司的钢装甲强一些，但是强的有限。”赫斯纳的话语十分的含糊，让首相的眉头微微一皱。
“那么你的意思是，新的战舰还是采购老厂商的装甲比较好？”俾斯麦问道。
“至少他们的价格是最合理的，而且老厂商毕竟质量有保证。”赫斯纳轻松的说道，似乎首相并没有打算在这个问题上纠缠下去。
“你看过这款装甲的测试报告了吗？”俾斯麦问道。
“看过！”赫斯纳毫不犹疑的说道。
“那么好了，告诉我，那些装甲生产商给了你多少钱，让你帮他们说话？”俾斯麦的双眼冷冷扫了对方一下，让后者不由的打了个哆嗦。
“这就是好的有限？根据这份报告上的描述，这种装甲的性能比普通钢面铁甲高了一倍左右！”首相将另外一份文件扔到了对面面前，低沉的话语中充满了愤怒！“你居然为了一己的私利去欺骗帝国！你胆子真大啊！”
“首相大人，您听我解释..。”赫斯纳脸色苍白，连话都说不利落了！
“等到了法庭上再解释吧！这件事情皇帝陛下已经知道了，他对帝国海军部中的某些人非常失望，非常愤怒。某些资本家的手已经伸的太远了！你现在最好回去好好想想自己的问题。然后供出同谋以换取皇帝陛下的怜悯。”俾斯麦根本不想听对方的解释，说完最后一句话后离开了会客厅。
“上帝啊，到底是什么人能让皇帝陛下亲自过问此事？这件事情原本不是海军内部就可以搞定的吗？”赫斯纳到现在都还没明白，自己得罪的是什么人！而这件事情的经过还要从一周前说起。
老实说，巴伐利亚未来的老大路德维希三世最近的心情还是很不错的，宝贝儿子搞出来的那根本不是装甲，而是一只会下金蛋的鸡啊！根据侍从提供的资料，他对世界装甲市场，特别是德国装甲市场上的利润有了一个基本的了解，可以这么说，依靠新式装甲优异的性能。巴伐利亚王室开设的工厂完全可以碾压其它竞争者，甚至垄断德国造舰装甲都不难！没人和钱过不去，所以鲁普雷希特王子心情非常好！
但是当巴伐利亚驻柏林的全权代表送来的书信上提到德国海军没有打算购买巴伐利亚王室独资设立的巴伐利亚机械设计局的新产品的时候，王子感到十分的费解，随后是不满，最后是愤怒！老子的东西这么好，你们居然敢不要？欺负老子是外地人？论性能，论性价比新式硬化装甲直接把老式装甲甩出去几条街！你们居然不要？这绝对不正常！

And now Bismarck, the chief executive of the Deutsche Group, is also worried about this matter. He is preparing to build a big project, but he has no goal yet! When it comes to playing strategy, domestic affairs, and diplomacy, Bismarck is at least at the level of the strongest king. But when it comes to the navy, even the German admirals haven't figured it out yet. How can they do it without knowing it? Although the direction is undecided, he already has a general direction based on the principle of strategic command gun. The scale of fleet construction should not be too large. Germany is now safe and the reinsurance treaty still exists. France does not dare to quarrel with Germany. Russia does not care to quarrel with itself. Italy and Austria-Hungary are friends, and Britain and itself are not enemies. The environment is unprecedentedly good. A huge fleet has no effect on Germany except bringing pressure and making others jealous!
Now, the iron-blooded Prime Minister had no time to think about this strategic issue, because Hessner, the State Secretary of the Imperial Navy Office, came to the Prime Minister's residence and was reporting to the Prime Minister. He provided a rough estimate as requested by the Admiralty, and some of the above attracted the Prime Minister's attention.
"The naval shipbuilding budget is a bit high. And the armor budget seems to be a bit ridiculously high. The empire's armor manufacturers have never quoted such a high price." Bismarck pointed to one of the rows of numbers and said.
"This is a quotation put forward by a new company called the Bavarian Mechanical Design Bureau. Their quotation is more than 50% higher than the quotations put forward by other companies! I really don't know what they think. The Ministry of the Navy does not intend to use their armor." Hessner said with some dissatisfaction.
"How is the quality of their armor?" The Prime Minister seemed not to want to get entangled in the quotation, but directly asked about the performance of the new armor.
"It is stronger than the steel armor of Baron Halberg's company and other companies, but its strength is limited." Hessner's words were very vague, making the Prime Minister frown slightly.
"So what do you mean, is it better to purchase armor from old manufacturers for new warships?" Bismarck asked.
"At least their prices are the most reasonable, and the quality of the old manufacturers is guaranteed after all." Hessner said easily, as if the Prime Minister had no intention of dwelling on this issue.
"Have you seen the test report of this armor?" Bismarck asked.
"I've seen it!" Hesner said without hesitation.
"Okay, tell me, how much did those armor manufacturers give you to speak for them?" Bismarck's eyes glanced at the other party coldly, making the latter tremble.
"Is this the limit of good? According to the description in this report, the performance of this kind of armor is about twice as high as ordinary steel-faced armor!" The Prime Minister threw another document in front of him, his low words full of anger! "You actually deceived the empire for your own selfish gain! How brave you are!"
"Prime Minister, please listen to my explanation..." Hessner's face turned pale and he couldn't even speak smoothly!
"Let's explain it in court! His Majesty the Emperor already knows about this matter. He is very disappointed and angry with some people in the Imperial Navy. Some capitalists have stretched their hands too far! You'd better go back and think about your problem now. Then confess your accomplices in exchange for His Majesty the Emperor's mercy." Bismarck didn't want to hear the other party's explanation at all, and left the living room after saying the last sentence.
"God, who can make His Majesty the Emperor personally intervene in this matter? Couldn't this matter be handled within the Navy?" Hesner still hasn't understood who he offended! And the story of this incident started a week ago.
To be honest, Ludwig III, the future boss of Bavaria, has been in a very good mood recently. What his precious son built was not armor at all, but a chicken that could lay golden eggs! According to the attendantFrom the information provided, he had a basic understanding of the world armor market, especially the profits in the German armor market, so to speak, relying on the excellent performance of new armor. The factories opened by the Bavarian royal family can completely crush other competitors, and it is not difficult to even monopolize German shipbuilding and armor! No one has anything to do with money, so Prince Ruprecht is in a very good mood!
But when the letter sent by the Bavarian plenipotentiary in Berlin mentioned that the German Navy had no intention to purchase new products from the Bavarian Mechanical Design Bureau established solely by the Bavarian royal family, the prince felt very puzzled, then dissatisfied, and finally angry! My stuff is so good, how dare you not want it? Are you bullying me for being a foreigner? In terms of performance and cost-effectiveness, the new hardened armor directly beats the old armor by a few blocks! You don't want it? This is definitely not normal!
